name: dsh-ui-chat-verbose-fold
description: Local runtime patch: make ui-chat's Verbose work-details mode fold completed Turns (POLICIES.verbose.foldCompletedTurns: true) without forking the official @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat package. It reuses the live slot ledger instead of replacing a component: the conversation.view#chat entry's inject factory is wrapped, and the shared presentation observable it returns is patched in place. ui-renderer's bindSnapshotSelector reads source.getSnapshot() dynamically, so selectors bound before the patch observe it without a remount. Nothing upstream is disabled or shadowed; when the target shape is absent the plugin is a no-op that reports once.
